question: What is the meaning of recycling system in relation to design for re-use?
description: Recycling system in relation to design for re-use involves focusing on the second life of materials by mainly recycling at a material level. This includes producing aggregates for road construction or backfilling, which is categorized as a form of downcycling. Downcycling reduces the value and quality of a material, contrasting with upcycling procedures, which aim to maintain or increase the value of materials.
